purpose: F1 thin-vocal dataset organization only; no beautification, EQ, compression, trimming beyond noted 15 s clips, or loudness normalization applied

category_rules.A_thin: 核心集。自录8条为主要测试对象；GTSinger 4条只作补充。分类为用户初步指定，未由本工具听感复核。
category_rules.B_full: 保护集。GTSinger 6条自然唱法，用于检查过度处理副作用；不是A类反例。
category_rules.C_observe: 条件变化观察集。全部来自 Mixed_Voice_and_Falsetto：3段混声 + 3段假声。ZH-Alto-1 3段（2混声+1假声），ZH-Tenor-1 3段（1混声+2假声）。同曲对照：Alto《十年》0003混声/假声，Tenor《曹操》0007混声/假声。不能当作充分跨歌手泛化测试。

gaps_and_warnings: 4 GTSinger A/B clips are slightly shorter than 8 s: 女A-001 7.34 s, 女B-001 7.97 s, 男B-001 7.51 s, 男B-002 6.11 s. Source-limited; not padded or extended.
2 self clips were trimmed to 15.0 s: 雅俗共赏-清唱版 (0.8-15.8 s) and 雅俗共赏-正常版 (0.2-15.2 s). Raw m4a files preserve the full recordings.
GTSinger A/B original song, singer ID, and HF path are not retained in the user-supplied filenames. If exact provenance is required, re-download or provide the original filenames.
A/thin and B/full labels are user-assigned; the agent cannot listen and has not acoustically verified thinness or fullness.

Self variant labels ('原版', '正常版', '清唱版') are user naming. '原版/正常版' a cappella status is not acoustically proven; all self files show very low sub-80 Hz energy (<0.04%), but this is not proof of no accompaniment.
F0 values are legacy 60-500 Hz autocorrelation diagnostics, not a full-range pitch guarantee and not a substitute for F2.
No loudness matching was applied in this dataset. Self file RMS spans about -24.6 to -15.6 dBFS; A/B listening must match loudness in the processing stage.
No F2 data is included and the F1/F2 interface contract is unchanged.
C_observe was rebuilt as requested: only Mixed_Voice_and_Falsetto, 3 mixed voice + 3 falsetto; the previous Breathy/Vibrato/Pharyngeal/Glissando C set was removed.

C01/C02 are the same song and segment (十年 0003) in mixed voice vs falsetto; C04/C05 are the same song and segment (曹操 0007) in mixed voice vs falsetto. Treat them as paired conditions, not four independent songs.
All 6 C clips are 8.30-13.57 s and have 0 clipped samples (C03 我们的明天 mixed 0006 is 8.30 s; C06 青花瓷 falsetto 0011 is 13.57 s).
Alto 我们的明天 mixed segments 0005 and 0002 were rejected for near-full-scale peaks (-0.05 and -0.00 dBFS); final C03 uses 0006 (peak -4.92 dBFS).
